230000400.text: There was that time in Mondstadt...

230000401.text: Huh? Mondstadt, the beloved land of the Anemo Archon...? According to the caravan, a gale-summoning dragon emerged there. That should make for a good story, I'm sure.

230000402.text: But you get nothing more than broken legends from the caravans, which can often sound rather fake.

230000403.text: Something like... "A winged Traveler came from the skies, pursuing the dragon tens of thousands of meters in the air!" or something like that.

230000406.text: #Hmm, and something like... "{M#He}{F#She} infiltrated the Cathedral alone, stealing a powerful weapon bestowed with the Anemo Archon's might!"

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the café and talk to Maddah

230000301.text: Ugh, is everyone leaving already? I hadn't even started my story yet...

230000302.text: My word. At this rate, I won't even be able to afford my coffee...

230000304.text: Um, are you... the Traveler? *sigh* As you can see, I exchange stories for coffee expenses here in this coffee shop.

230000305.text: But I'm drawing smaller and smaller audiences recently... At this rate, I doubt that I'll be able to afford even coffee foam.

230000308.text: Well... I haven't met one, but I suppose we might be quite similar, yes.

230000309.text: You know, the ancient heroic legends are intriguing, but no tale stays attractive if you tell it day after day... I have to find some new material.

230000310.text: *sigh* Stories from outside Sumeru are the best. They are new and interesting, and...

230000311.text: I'm at liberty to make adaptations. No one would notice, since no one actually knows what really happened... *cough*!

230000312.text: However, I must first understand the stories that I mean to tell.

230000313.text: I have collected tales from all over the world, such as the story of Dvalin, the Rite of Parting, and so on...

230000314.text: But I got these stories from others, and I'm sure they must have already come to me embellished. I don't quite trust those stories.

230000315.text: Traveler, I have heard from the Adventurers' Guild that you have been traveling the world. Is that true?

230000316.text: Could you please tell me about your experiences around the world, then?

230000317.text: That would allow me to get my stories straight and make them sound somewhat more believable...

230000318.text: Of course, we'll split my earnings from the stories I tell!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the café and talk to Maddah

230001301.text: *sigh* You're here, Traveler. What do you think of the story I told today?

230001303.text: Well... That's about the same as what the other listeners said. I might have focused too much on drama, neglecting "truthfulness" in the process.

230001304.text: *sigh* More changes are needed for these stories to work, I guess...

230001305.text: Thanks for the stories, by the way. Please, take this as payment.

230001306.text: Don't forget to share new stories with me when you come across them!

230000500.text: There was that time in Liyue...

230000501.text: Huh? Liyue... According to the caravans, the various factions struggled and schemed against each other when their Archon fell. That should make for a great story.

230000502.text: But you get nothing more than broken legends from the caravans, which can often sound rather fake.

230000503.text: Something like... "the Traveler who organized the Rite of Parting became a figure much-sought-after by all sides."

230000506.text: #Well, or something like... "{M#He}{F#She} confronted the Overlord of the Vortex above the seas, sweeping even the Jade Chamber into the waves with the power of {M#his}{F#her} blade!"

230000600.text: So we did have this adventure in Inazuma...

230000601.text: Huh? Inazuma, the blessed land of the Electro Archon...? The caravans bring word that some defied the Archon's Vision Hunt Decree. That should make for an excellent tale.

230000602.text: But the caravans only bring scattered tales that never quite sound reliable...

230000603.text: #You know, things like "An Outlander initiated a duel against a Fatui Harbinger, turning {M#his}{F#her} opponent to ash with one strike!"

230000606.text: #Well, or something like, "{M#He}{F#She} stood against the formidable Shogun, escaping her Musou no Hitotachi without a single scratch!"

230000701.text: I see... Though the drama has been cut down a fair bit, these stories do indeed sound more "truthful."

230000702.text: It really felt like I was talking to a true witness! Well, these legends make far more sense now, indeed...

230000703.text: Thank you, Traveler. Now that I've figured all this out, please, do stop by to hear my stories tomorrow night!

230000801.text: I see... So the legends are basically true? Wow, fact really is stranger than fiction sometimes.

230000802.text: But I suppose these tales wouldn't have spread had they not been utterly amazing, eh? Guess I can bring them up a notch, to boot...

230000803.text: Thank you, Traveler. I think I've figured all this out, so please, do stop by to hear my stories tomorrow night!

230000901.text: Hmm... This could use a few touches here as well...

230001001.text: Ahem, today's tale took place in a faraway land. Please enjoy "The Song of Anemo and the Dragon"!

230001002.text: ...Back when the dragon came, none knew its name. Who could save Mondstadt from peril? Who would keep its creatures safe?

230001003.text: ...The destined warrior spread their wings, the Holy Lyre der Himmel in hand, yes, the very tool of the Anemo Archon. Its strings brought forth the thousand winds, showing forth its mountain-moving might!

230001004.text: ...The warrior roared, their blade blazing like a falling star! The dragon lay defeated in the ruins, its slayer stronger than ever!

230001005.text: The story... It's pretty new, and yet, the events don't flow logically at all.

230001006.text: The protagonist just started the fight without a word and defeated the dragon way too quickly... It just seems somewhat weird...

230001007.text: Um... Well... Today's story ends here! Please do come again! Haha...

230001101.text: So! The story today took place in a faraway country. Please enjoy "The Tale of the Golden-Haired Hero"!

230001102.text: ...When the Exuvia fell from the sky, ancient Stone Harbor was in chaos. But thanks to this traveler's feat, the land saw peace once again.

230001103.text: ...However, a monster emerged from the waters, and fierce battle was joined. Even the sky changed color, and the very land was thrown out of order. Even the Jade Chamber was blown to smithereens!

230001104.text: ...The waves settled, but conflicts remained. The Traveler stood forth to quell the disagreements between mortal and adeptus. Their sage words turned the tide, ushering Liyue onto a new path!

230001105.text: The story... It's pretty new, and yet, the events don't flow logically at all.

230001106.text: That's right! How did the protagonist persuade both sides even though the protagonist hasn't said much before then...?

230001107.text: Um... Well... Today's story ends here! Please do come again! Haha...

230001201.text: Well then, the story for today took place in a faraway country. Please enjoy "An Outland Blade in Inazuma"!

230001202.text: #...The thunder can be heard beyond distant seas — the destined Traveler is about to arrive. {M#He}{F#She} roamed the islands like lightning, {M#his}{F#her} great deeds sung of by all.

230001203.text: ...Though aforetime she did as she pleased, the wicked witch could not escape defeat. Even the sea-severing strike could not halt the Traveler's steps!

230001204.text: ...And the Statue of the Omnipresent God, powered by the wishes of thousands of hearts, shattered the skies with a mighty roar, casting all enemies to the wayside!

230001205.text: The story... It's pretty new, and yet, the events don't flow logically at all.

230001206.text: That whole bit with the giant statue just comes out of nowhere, almost as if we were running out of believable story bits or something...

230001207.text: Um... Well... Today's story ends here! Please do come again! Haha...

230001401.text: Ahem, today's tale took place in a faraway land. Please enjoy "The Song of Anemo and the Dragon"!

230001402.text: ...Back when the dragon came, none knew its name. Who could save Mondstadt from peril? Who would keep its creatures safe?

230001403.text: ...The hero came forth on the wind, as the bard played his lyre and sang softly: "Why has a thousand-year vigil been ended in a single day? The toxic blood of the Abyss has clouded the dragon's perception."

230001404.text: ...The demonic wind cleared, and the toxic blood was cleansed. Please, all you who come after, carve that name into your memory. For who is this song dedicated to? The Dragon of the East, Dvalin!

230001405.text: Hey! There we go! Now that's an interesting story!

230001406.text: The antagonist turned out to be forced into that position... That's always a moving development.

230001407.text: Today's story ends here. Please do come again!

230001501.text: So! The story today took place in a faraway country. Please enjoy "The Tale of the Golden-Haired Hero"!

230001502.text: ...When the Exuvia plummeted from the skies, the ancient stone harbor was plunged into chaos, and the Sea of Clouds churned in the shadows. So did the Traveler arrive, and so was pulled into the vortex.

230001503.text: ...Despite the many conflicts along the way, all was put aside to defend a shared home. Osial of the Vortex emerged from the seas, and moonlight shone upon the Jade Chamber in the skies. Its delicate construction sank 'midst the flow, but at great expense, they delivered the final blow!

230001504.text: ...Liyue has been open to all peoples throughout the Geo Archon's reign — to embrace an era without their archon is no impossible thing! Nestlings must now fly on their own — the ancient Stone Harbor shines anew!

230001505.text: Hey! There we go! Now that's an interesting story!

230001506.text: Opposing sides establishing trust in cooperation... Now that's what I call, reliable plot development!

230001507.text: Today's story ends here. Please do come again!

230001601.text: Well then, the story for today took place in a faraway country. Please enjoy "An Outland Blade in Inazuma"!

230001602.text: #...The thunder can be heard beyond distant seas — the destined Traveler is about to arrive. {M#He}{F#She} roamed the islands like lightning, {M#his}{F#her} great deeds sung of by all.

230001603.text: ...The Harbinger fell before the throne — her arrogance her undoing. The Traveler's friends came to the rescue, blocking the thunderous strike of a god unmoving!

230001604.text: ...Countless stars whirled over the empty realm — each one the wish of a mortal's heart. Thus did those who lived in the land move the divine will of a god!

230001605.text: Hey! There we go! Now that's an interesting story!

230001606.text: Hmm... Facing difficulties together with one's friends. That's what heroic tales should be about!

230001607.text: Today's story ends here. Please do come again!

230001701.text: Ah, so you came, Traveler! What do you think of the story today?

230001704.text: Haha, so you concur with the other listeners, then? In a new era, we shall have new heroes and tales.

230001705.text: Thanks to them, people like me always have a living to earn... Oh, and thanks to you, I can finally afford a nice coffee.

230001706.text: Thanks for the stories you shared with me. Please, take this as your payment.

230001707.text: Don't forget to share new stories with me when you come across them!
